question: Seize the Spoils ({2}{R} sorcery: discard a card as a cost, draw two, make a Treasure -- Big Score's three-mana sorcery twin) in -- and for what?

contributions.text:
The deck doctor on study 035 (NO CHANGE; try only, one instrument, 10,000 paired games).
A worse Big Score: one mana less, one Treasure instead of two, and a sorcery, so no end-step cast with Counterspell/Mana Drain/Swat mana held up. Per cast: one discard (Brallin), two draws (Shabraz, doubled by Krang), one Treasure. Another non-permanent where the pilot wants more permanents; filler that copies Big Score, not a new axis.
- out Wheel of Fortune: 4 better, 9 worse; damage @T10 -14.7 [-18.1, -11.2]; killed by T6 -1.8 pts [-2.1, -1.5]; finisher wheel by T8 -8.0 pts [-8.5, -7.4]; Wheel carries stacks 009-011.
- out Willie Lumpkin: 2 better, 7 worse; damage @T10 -7.2 [-10.3, -4.1]; stall +0.9 pts [+0.7, +1.1].
- out Brainstorm: 1 better, 6 worse; killed by T6 -0.4 pts [-0.7, -0.1]; damage -3.2 [-6.6, +0.3] no call.
- out Shelter: 8 better, 3 worse; damage @T10 +5.9 [+2.1, +9.8]; killed by T6 +0.4 pts [+0.1, +0.6]. Not a reason: the goldfish prices Shelter's protection at zero (no removal, no opponents), so the row is only its cantrip against a draw-two and a Treasure; protection is for the A team.
No screen clears the bar except one resting on a blind spot. Leave the slot alone.
